verdicts.reason: A keeps the original left/centre/right text arrangement and the diagonal guide lines, but the mint panel is pushed hard left and almost touches the top edge, leaving a big empty wood strip on the right, so the banner looks like a bad crop. Its side copy is also tiny. B centres a full-height panel with wood on both sides, which is balanced, but its text forms an arbitrary staircase: the headline is centred, the left copy drops below it, and the right copy sinks to the bottom-right corner in very small type. B also loses the decorative cross lines and uses the panel's width poorly. Both fail; B's overall frame is a little more deliberate.
